stories.title: North Wales man jailed over £4m of machinery obtained on finance
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man has been jailed for five years after taking heavy plant machinery on finance and selling it abroad without repaying the loans. Jordan Davies, 42, of Victoria Road, was sentenced at Liverpool Crown Court on Wednesday 23 September after being found guilty of conspiracy to steal. The case was investigated by the North

stories.title: Flintshire roadworks: closures and temporary traffic lights across the county this week
stories.summary: Road closures and temporary traffic lights are in place across Flintshire this week, with works in Shotton, Mold, Buckley, Hope and Pen-y-ffordd among those listed in Flintshire County Council’s roadworks bulletin. The bulletin covers the week ending Friday 2 October. Four-way temporary lights are in place on Chester Road West in Shotton from Monday 28

stories.title: Deeside Industrial Park 20mph limit set to be reversed on most roads
stories.summary: Roads across Deeside Industrial Park will return to 30mph from 16 October, reversing the 20mph limit brought in under Wales’ default speed limit in 2023. stories.title: Diesel close to all-time high as Fflint Wrecsam MS questions Welsh Government on fuel
stories.summary: Fflint Wrecsam MS Nigel Williams says he has asked the Welsh Government whether it has raised fuel prices with retailers and the UK Government, as diesel nears a record high. The average price of a litre of diesel reached 198.32p on Friday, according to the RAC, less than a penny short of the all-time high

stories.title: MS raises Flintshire Catholic school closures in the Senedd ahead of special Cabinet meeting
stories.summary: Sam Rowlands MS has urged Flintshire’s Cabinet to scrap plans to close four Catholic schools and build a 3-18 super-school in Flint. Mr Rowlands, a Welsh Conservative Member of the Senedd for Fflint Wrecsam, said the council’s Cabinet was due to consider the plans again. A special meeting of Flintshire County Council’s Cabinet is scheduled
